name: Warehouse management (Dynamics 365)
short_description: The warehouse management capabilities of Dynamics 365 that guide physical warehouse work such as receiving, put-away, picking and loading, for example with mobile scanning, barcodes and license plates.

evidence.quote: In a large operation, warehouse management can direct that work through mobile scanning and warehouse rules.
That outams, where Dynamics 365 Warehouse Management comes in.
Warehouse management handles the daily work around those items.
